verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no official SDKs for ComplyAdvantage Mesh. The docs offer a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema, which are developer building blocks a user could generate client code from, not first-party SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: ComplyAdvantage offers a Postman collection to help you on your integration journey
